groups.talkText: We have some exciting news! Next month, our local Pine Valley Supermarket will join the national Apex family of grocers. This means incredible new benefits for you, our loyal customers. In our all-new mobile application, you'll find dozens of digital coupons each week. You can also shop from the convenience of your own home with our enhanced delivery service. Receive half off the delivery fee on any order over one hundred dollars!

choices.A: A business merger will take place.

choices.A: It allows customers to earn bonus points.
choices.C: A discount is available for it.
choices.D: A minimum purchase must be made to use it.

groups.talkText: Before we end our meeting today, I have two updates that'll affect our library. First, the parking area's being resurfaced on Sunday. Although we'll be closed, we'll post signs letting patrons know they can access the book return box by using the walkway on the east side of the building. Also, we met our fund-raising goal to modernize our building's technology systems! I can't list all the benefits, but new computers will start arriving Monday. More exciting updates will follow.

groups.talkText: Everyone—thanks for your help moving the leftover summer and fall items to the back of the store. OK. The shipment of winter wear—coats, sweaters, and hats—should arrive soon. The truck driver just texted me. Can anyone help unload the truck? ... Thanks for volunteering, Tariq and Rodrigo. I appreciate it! Oh, and did anyone see that today's newspaper advertisement says seasonal sale is tomorrow? Well, that sales promotion is next week. Be sure to tell customers about it if they ask you. I'm sure it's going to cause some confusion.

groups.talkText: Are you looking for a fun family getaway this summer? Come join us at Robinson's Resort, home of the largest water park on the east coast. We just completed renovating the entire park, and there are now six outdoor pools and nine new waterslides to enjoy! After a day full of fun in the sun, unwind in the comfort of rooms with a wood-cabin aesthetic feel as though you are far from the city. Call 555-0179 now to book a weekend your family will never forget!

groups.talkText: This is Fernanda Alvarez reporting live from Sweet Snack Cupcakes. Today marks the store's one-year anniversary, and everyone is invited to come down to the shop and celebrate the occasion. Throughout the weekend, there will be plenty of activities for visitors of all ages. I highly recommend seeing the baking demonstrations! Also, everyone can receive a complimentary cup of coffee or soft drink with the purchase of any cupcake from now through Sunday.

groups.talkText: Attention Central Station customers and MTS riders! This is a reminder that all next week we'll be operating under a special schedule. This will include extra trains and bus routes to accommodate increased passenger traffic. We anticipate thousands of people will be visiting the city to celebrate 100 years since Plattville was founded. Trains may be especially busy in the area around the city center and the historic district. To ensure that your commute will not be disrupted, visit our Web site for the most up-to-date schedule and traffic information. Thank you and enjoy the ride!

groups.talkText: Andersonville Office Superstore is happy to announce a new service! More people have begun working from home recently, so we're now offering free home delivery to our corporate clients. Your employees can expect to receive the same high-quality supplies and fast, dependable service that they've always had, but now at the convenience of their own doorstep. How's that for an improvement? To register for this new service, contact a sales representative. They'll guarantee that any corporate discount is applied to all orders.

I'm calling because Mr. Molina was scheduled to return from an international business trip on Friday and then meet with you the following day. The thing is, though, his trip has been extended by one day. Please give me a call back or stop by my office so we can discuss other options. I'll be at my desk the rest of the afternoon.

groups.graphic: Development Schedule table: Preview May 18, Testing June 12, Feedback July 29, Launch August 30
groups.talkText: I called this meeting to update you on the timeline to deliver the Auto-Check software we've been developing for our client Super Speed Automotive. Next week, a representative from Super Speed will visit our office to see a preview and ask questions. Super Speed wants to ensure the software includes all the requested functionalities. By the middle of June, a select number of Super Speed employees will begin using a beta version, and they will report their experience by the end of July. Finally, we will work on software repairs to address any issues that the client encountered throughout August and roll out the final product at the end of August.

groups.talkText: Everyone, as we get closer to the sales department's annual awards ceremony, I've assigned tasks for the awards committee to work on. As the sales director, I'll personally create the awards and decide which members of the team will be recognized. The task of purchasing prizes has always been difficult, so let me know if you need additional advice. Also, as part of receiving approval to hold this event, our department was allocated some supplemental funding. We'll use this funding to purchase catering for the event and buy the prizes.
